subject: Dovetailed onramp: evening console + API blocks?
messages:
From: Oliver Neal <oliver@rivermarklabs.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rivermark Labs Onboarding <onboarding@rivermarklabs.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onramp: console/API team training — evening availability?

Hi Maya,

Hope you’re well. We’re lining up an internal onramp for the platform and want to propose an evening slot (US Pacific) that works across our engineering and product teams. Goal: full-console walkthrough (45m) followed immediately by an API deep-dive (60–75m). We have folks in EMEA who can join asynchronously but would really value an evening window so our US teams can attend live.

Rivermark’s preferred week is the week of June 7 — do you have a recommended evening that aligns with your enablement rotation? Also: can Redwood dovetail coverage so we don’t lose momentum between console -> API?

Attendees (tentative): Oliver Neal (SRE), Priya Singh (Product), Daniel Kim (Backend).

Thanks — Oliver
Rivermark Labs

---
Note: we’ll need an ics invite and a short runbook PDF with connection checks and service account details.
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Neal <oliver@rivermarklabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Rivermark Labs Onboarding <onboarding@rivermarklabs.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp: console/API team training — evening availability?

On Sun, May 30, 2027 at 3:12 PM Oliver Neal <oliver@rivermarklabs.com> wrote:
> Hi Maya,
> We’re lining up an internal onramp ...

Thanks for the clear ask, Oliver — we can definitely support a dovetailed evening session. To avoid drop-off between console and API, we usually either: 1) run a single continuous 2-hr block with a 10-min break, or 2) split into two back-to-back sessions led by different engineers (console ops -> API lead). Both approaches work; the split eases deep-dive ownership.

Ben, Evelyn — can you cover the API deep-dive + token/key preflight if we do a back-to-back? I’ll own the console walkthrough and the runbook.

Proposed slots (US Pacific):
- Tue, Jun 8, 18:00–20:00 PDT (continuous 2-hr)
- Wed, Jun 9, 18:00–19:30 PDT (console 18:00–18:45; break 18:45–18:55; API 18:55–19:30)

Oliver — which of the two options do you prefer? If Wed 9th looks good, we’ll send the ics and a short runbook (connection checks, API keys matrix) and ask for any extra SSO/KMS contacts ahead of time.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: onboarding_runbook_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Oliver Neal <oliver@rivermarklabs.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp: console/API team training — evening availability?

Thanks Maya — I can take the API segment for the Wed split. Quick notes:
- I’ll bring an example prompt set and lay out best-practice batching/quantization knobs (20–30 min).
- Need a named API key or temporary token for live calls; if Rivermark prefers not to use prod keys we can run against a sandbox model we’ll provision.
- I’ve attached a tentative agenda matrix that maps questions -> SME (console, API, infra).

Attaching: api_console_split_agenda.xlsx

If we go continuous 2-hr, Jordan can handle the second half if I need to hop to a support incident.

Ben
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: api_console_split_agenda.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
From: Oliver Neal <oliver@rivermarklabs.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rivermark Labs Onboarding <onboarding@rivermarklabs.com>, Priya Singh <priya@rivermarklabs.com>, Daniel Kim <daniel@rivermarklabs.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp: console/API team training — evening availability?

Maya / Ben — thanks for the options. We prefer the split on Wed, Jun 9 (console 18:00–18:45; API 18:55–19:30) so our product folks can step out during the short break. Please provision a sandbox token for the API portion and include the runbook items for SSO checks.

I’ll confirm final attendee list by EOD Friday (we may add one more infra engineer). If you can send the ics and the runbook+agenda today that’d be great — we’ll circulate internally.

Oliver
SRE, Rivermark Labs
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Neal <oliver@rivermarklabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Rivermark Labs Onboarding <onboarding@rivermarklabs.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp: console/API team training — evening availability? (CONFIRMED)

Great — Wed, Jun 9 confirmed. I’ve attached the ics invite and updated runbook + agenda (sandbox token notes included). Quick checklist for Rivermark prior to the session:
- Confirm final attendee list and which of those need sandbox API access
- Share SSO admin contact or a temporary service account for the demo SSO flow
- Ensure everyone has the join link (ICS attached) and a test connection before the session start

Attachments: dovetail-invite.ics, onboarding_runbook_v2.pdf, api_console_split_agenda.xlsx

We’ll set a 10-minute pre-join for hosts at 17:45 PDT to validate keys and breakout links. See you then.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: dovetail-invite.ics (text/calendar)]
